audience: Chief architect · senior architect · sector ICT lead

videos.title: Use AI as a drafting partner, not an oracle — the ground rules
videos.message: AI is a fast drafting partner for EA work, not an oracle — it produces a strong first draft you verify, never a finding you trust. Learn the four-part prompt pattern and the one rule that makes every play safe: you decide, the AI drafts.

videos.title: Play 1 — Draft your Discovery and Assess artefacts
videos.message: The first play turns your raw Discovery notes into a structured capture template and then a ranked gap analysis — the two hardest-to-start artefacts of the assessment — in a fraction of the time, with the politics flagged for you to handle honestly.

videos.title: Play 2 — Build the whole-of-government re-use business case
videos.message: The second play builds the business case that makes re-use visible — a cost comparison showing that each project building its own is cheaper for the project but ruinous for the country — the number that wins the budget argument.

videos.title: Play 3 — Translate between the minister and the architects
videos.message: The third play is a translator — it turns a minister's policy goal into architecture terms and a joint agenda, and architecture decisions back into outcomes a minister understands — so the business side and the IT side can actually decide together.

videos.title: Play 4 — Draft your governance artefacts
videos.message: The fourth play drafts the institutional documents governance needs — the Board terms of reference, the review-gate checklist, the gate-decision paper — so you arrive at the meeting with a strong draft to edit, not a blank page to dread.

videos.title: Play 5 — Generate comparator cases and a sector-transfer plan
videos.message: The fifth play generates the persuasion material — comparator-country cards tuned to your context with real sources, and a one-page plan to run the method on a new sector — for the briefings and pitches where you need evidence and a path.

videos.title: Keep AI honest — verify, cite, and protect data
videos.message: The safeguards that make every play safe: verify each output against a named source, cite or discard, never paste confidential or personal data, and keep the decision human — the difference between AI that helps and AI that quietly harms.
